---
title: "Examples from the help file"
subtitle: "The examples in help usetdm, run in full"
---

The two examples at the end of `help usetdm`, each followed by `describe`
so that the loaded data are visible. The [full list of datasets](index.html#available-datasets)
is on the overview page.

```{.stata-run}
. usetdm gss, clear
Loading dataset...
(gss.dta | GSS 1972 - 2016 Data | DMV Workshop)

. describe, short

Contains data from https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/gss.dta
 Observations:        62,466                  gss.dta | GSS 1972 - 2016 Data | DMV Workshop
    Variables:           113                  24 Mar 2018 14:28
Sorted by: 

```

```{.stata-run}
. usetdm addhealth4, clear
Loading dataset...
(addhealth4_dmv.dta | Add Health Wave IV | DMV Workshop)

. describe, short

Contains data from https://tdmize.github.io/data/data/addhealth4.dta
 Observations:         4,307                  addhealth4_dmv.dta | Add Health Wave IV | DMV
                                                Workshop
    Variables:            79                  20 Mar 2018 15:08
Sorted by: AID

```
